log.how: sha256( prev + "\n" + lines joined by "\n" ), UTF-8; each line is one JSON object per record of the Adoption Register as it was when the day was hashed (the statement by statement_sha256; trace_url, trace_host, key fingerprint, pubkey and sig; state and category); trace checks and decisions are in each record's log; a forced recomputation is recorded in register_hash_revisions

copies.note: committed to the public repository by the daily-archive job (01:20 and 07:20 UTC), once verify.py has checked the whole chain; absent until then

untrusted_content: Statements are user content; none are the record's.
